statement: For an algebraizable strict-local germ over Fpbar admitting a regular projective SNC resolution with a positive exceptional combination whose negative restricts amply, rational top Chow of the resolution is the vector space of component degrees and rational top Chow of the puncture vanishes
depends_on: Levine1994 Th3.1 and arbitrary-scheme Adams paragraph p258; Totaro1992 Th1; GH2011 ThA/C; KST ThA/(1.6); TT8.1; rational Chern character; negative-definite exceptional degree matrix
notes: Restricted resolution and ample-exceptional hypotheses are explicit. Full root and real_weil proof/source audits pass. No arbitrary-germ resolution, integral vanishing, transcendental-field extension, or actual-family lifting is asserted.
